# storage-seaweedfs

<!-- BEGIN DECLARED (generated by scripts/wiki-compile.py — do not edit) -->

> Source comment, verbatim from `kustomization.yaml`:
>
> SeaweedFS — S3-compatible object storage, run by the seaweedfs-operator.
>
> Ships the operator (Helm chart, with its CRDs) and one `Seaweed` cluster in the
> `single` shape: one master, one volume server, one filer and a standalone S3
> gateway on port 8333 with embedded IAM. Replication is "000"; durability comes
> from the tenant's StorageClass (e.g. a replicated Longhorn class).
>
> Installation uses the Kustomize helmCharts generator:
> kustomize build --enable-helm k8s/components/apps/storage/seaweedfs
> In Argo CD this needs `kustomize.buildOptions: --enable-helm` in argocd-cm.
>
> Pinned on 2026-11-24 (latest releases that day):
> chart seaweedfs-operator-0.1.49, operator 1.0.46, SeaweedFS 4.55
>
> What the tenant patches:
> - StorageClass: spec.{master,filer}.persistence.storageClassName and
> spec.volume.storageClassName on the Seaweed (unset = cluster default)
> - PVC sizes: master 1Gi, filer 1Gi, volume 10Gi by default
> - client namespaces: label each namespace that talks S3 with
> forjate.io/object-store-client: "true" (NetworkPolicy admits port 8333 from them)
>
> Buckets, identities and policies are CRs the overlay declares; examples/ is not
> part of resources, copy what you need (see README).
